target_definition: T+1 open to T+6 open five-trading-day interval return, industry and log-float-market-cap neutralized and cross-sectionally ranked

rejected_target.name: target_path_rank
rejected_target.reason: It improved two of three annual return/Sharpe pairs and full-period drawdown, but failed to beat the endpoint target under the preregistered 20bp fixed-path cost stress.

selection_basis: The engineered endpoint candidate improved development-period GBRT historical return, Sharpe, drawdown, 20bp stress return and Rank IC versus v0.1. The path target was rejected before the holdout was reopened.
unmet_gates: Holdout annual return does not exceed the CSI 300 benchmark.
Deflated Sharpe Ratio and complete multiple-testing inventory are not evaluated.
Announcement-quality financial PIT data and forward paper trading are not complete.
